uniteDbPokemon.notes: Unite-DB public pokemon.json. v3 enumerates skills, boosted basic attacks, nested upgrade choices, Plus/enhanced effects, Unite Moves, and Unite Buffs.

sourceList.originalDescription: When this Ability is used: cleanses status conditions and becomes unstoppable for 0.33s (15s CD); and takes the form of the nearest opposing Pokémon for up to 15s, prioritizing Pokémon from the opposing team. Returns to their original form earlier when damaged, using an auto attack or move, attempting to score, or returning to base. The target of the illusion does not need to be in vision to take their form. The user takes the form of a random wild Pokémon or Pokémon from the opposing team. The user returns to their original form when taking damage or using an auto attack or move (15s cd).
Becomes a boosted with every third attack, dealing increased damage. Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage.
Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage.
Dashes forward, damaging opposing Pokémon hit. Dashes in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies hit.

Dashes forward, damaging opposing Pokémon in the path and stunning them for 0.05s when it hits; if hit at the endpoint of the dash, throw them for 0.4s instead. Dash in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies hit and leaving them unable to act for a short time. If this move hits an enemy near the end point of the dash, they will be thrown instead of being left unable to act.
Strengthens the duration of the throw at the endpoint to 0.5s. Increases the length of time enemies are thrown.
Dashes forward, damaging opposing Pokémon; restoring HP when it hits. Dashes in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies, and restoring the Zoroark's HP.
Strengthened amount of HP restored. Increases the amount of HP this move restores.

Dashes forward, damaging opposing Pokémon hit. If this move hits, this move can be used again within 4s. Dashes in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies. If this move hits an enemy, for a short time afterwards, this move can be activated again.

Gains the Night Slash buff for 2.5s, changing the next movement to a dash attack, damaging opposing Pokémon in the path. If the dash attack hits: changes the next auto attack to a unique boosted attack with increased range. If Zoroark hits opposing Pokémon with Slash, Shadow Claw, Cut, or unique boosted attacks: resets the Night Slash buff duration to 2.5s, repeating this chain of attacks. This move ends if the user moves when they're unable to use the Night Slash dash attack. If Zoroark hits opposing Pokémon with a total of 6 valid attacks: cleanses status conditions and becomes invincible for 1.4s, jumping into the air then landing after 1.2s. When the user lands: slashes a cross-shaped area of effect, damaging opposing Pokémon with two diagonal slashes, and dealing additional missing HP damage when it hits; restores HP once for each of the two diagonal areas of the cross slash that hits an opposing Pokémon (up to 2 times if both slashes hit). This cross-shaped attack deals move damage if triggered by a final move hit, or auto attack damage if triggered by a final unique boosted attack. While jumping, the user is able to use Slash, Shadow Claw, or Cut to move a set distance. Deals an additional 10% missing HP damage. Against wild Pokémon: total damage is capped at 1000. For a short time, change the user’s normal movement to dash attacks. After performing a dash attack, the user’s next auto attack changes to a special auto attack. During this move’s effect duration, whenever Zoroark hits an enemy with other moves or special auto attacks, this move’s effect duration increases and the user is able to use Night Slash again. This move’s effect duration ends if the user moves when it’s unable to use Night Slash. During this move’s effect duration, if Zoroark hits enemies with a total of six moves and/or special auto attacks, Zoroark will jump into the air and then while landing, slash a set area-of-effect, dealing damage to enemies. Zoroark recovers HP if they hit enemies with this slashing attack. While jumping, the user is able to use Shadow Claw or Cut to move a set distance.
Reduces this move's cooldown by 1s. Reduces this move's cooldown by 1s.

Dashes forward, damaging opposing Pokémon in the path and resetting move cooldowns when it hits. If this move hits, the location where the dash started is marked for 3s, and this move can be used again to return to the marked location with the same effects as the first dash. As long as there is a mark, using Slash, Shadow Claw, or Cut moves the mark to where that move started. If Zoroark hits opposing Pokémon 4 times with either Feint Attack or other normal moves without interrupting the chain of marking: changes the next use of Feint Attack for 3s. When used again: becomes unstoppable for 0.5s and leaps at the designated opposing Pokémon; then bounces in the designated direction forward off the target to perform a slashing attack, damaging the target and opposing Pokémon in the path, dealing additional missing HP damage to those hit. Deals an additional 15% missing HP damage. Against wild Pokémon: total damage is capped at 1200. Dashes in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies and reducing all of the user’s move cooldowns. If this move hits an enemy, for a short time, the location where the dash started is marked, and the user is able to use this move again; returning to the marked location and dealing damage to enemies. A new mark is left where the dash started. As long as there is a mark, if the user uses another move, the mark will move to where the move was used. If the user hits enemies four times with either Feint Attack or other moves without interrupting the chain of marking, the next use of Feint Attack changes. If this changed form of Feint Attack is used, Zoroark leaps at the designated enemy and deals damage to them before landing in the designated direction.
Reduces this move's cooldown by 1s. Reduces this move's cooldown by 1s.

Becomes unstoppable for 1.33s, and releases dark shockwaves with increasing areas of effect around themself 3 times over the first 1s, damaging opposing Pokémon hit with each shockwave. Release dark shockwaves, dealing damage to enemies hit. Three shockwaves are released, and each one has an increasingly larger area-of-effect. Zoroark is immune to hindrances while releasing shockwaves.
Buffs: 80% Movement Speed, 20% Max HP Shield Buff duration: 6
